items.title: Dipke posts 'Some factcheck' IG reel rebutting AI-generated-image impersonation and viral claims around his grandmother's death
items.summary: Founder Abhijeet Dipke's own Instagram (@abhijeetdipke) posted a reel (~33.6K likes, caption 'Some factcheck', posted ~1:54 PM IST Oct 13) in which a man speaking to camera addresses two viral controversies: (1) he denies Dipke posted AI-generated police-officer images on Facebook, saying Dipke has no Facebook page (only a personal profile), so he could not have made that post; (2) he addresses confusion over whose grandmother died — claiming Dipke's own grandmother passed away long ago, that it was cousin Vihaan's grandmother (Vihaan's Daadi) who died Oct 10, and that Dipke mistakenly shared Vihaan's Daadi's photo and later apologized. NOTE: this second claim CONTRADICTS the established arc (Dipke's father lost his mother Oct 10; Delhi Police's informing-video; Dipke's Hingoli last-rites trip; his tribute posts). Ambiguity unresolved: unclear whether the speaker is Dipke himself or a third-party clip Dipke amplified; caption framing suggests a debunk, but no news outlet has covered this reel (single-sourced). Companion IG story (~1:07 PM IST Oct 13): 'Can't wait to see what new conspiracy theories the IT cell comes up with.'
